answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-reserves identity: each identity must publish a zero-knowledge proof that it controls a distinct, unencumbered reserve, like a harbor that admits only ships with their own cargo manifest. Reserves are jade-marked commitments no two identities may share, so clones drawing on one pot are exposed at once. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must lock ten thousand separate reserves, climbing a ridge of real capital per fake, while an honest agent proves one reserve cheaply and keeps its standing.
